title: Luigi's company attacked, court demand for Lazar communications

tellings.quote: To to zero and we were attacked. Nobody knows this, but we were attacked ferociously for over a year and a half.

plain: Luigi Vendittelli, a researcher from Montreal who has worked with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft for the US government, says that in the 2020s his company was "attacked ferociously for over a year and a half" until it fell to zero. He says that along the way a court document demanded his communications with Lazar. Vendittelli tells it as his own experience, a sign to him that being close to Lazar drew hostile attention.
